correctness.rationale: Grounding retains diagonal 2+mu and splits the matrix into paths on g_i-1 vertices. A closed step word of span R has (ell-R)_+ translations into an ell-vertex path, so every trace of an even adjacency power is discretely convex in ell. At ell>=1 the word going ell steps each way witnesses strictness at order 2ell; its coefficient is positive both in the heat expansion and in the absolutely convergent inverse-power expansion (path adjacency norm strictly below 2). Strict gap transfers give exactly the stated multisets. Counting gap words with an anchor gives N binom(k,r)/k, and the unique long gap has N possible starting vertices unless k=N, when there is only the empty follower problem. The degenerate cases k=1 and k=N-1 agree. Independently, det(T_{g-1})=sinh(g theta)/sinh(theta) by the tridiagonal recurrence; its mu-log-derivative is the claimed inverse trace, with limit (g^2-1)/6. A fresh bounded check used integer path-walk recurrences (80 second differences, up to length 18) and 75 (N,k) groups of labeled masks, N<=12. Replay: /workspace/branches/spectral_design_replays.js, cycleCheck. The supplied check.py was inspected, not run; its floating-point assertions are supplementary. Neither exact integer finite checks nor the uploaded evidence constitute a formal proof certificate.
